english.note: Use this for something physically sticking or clinging to another thing.
Use 黐住 as the all-purpose choice for something physically adhering, including being attached with glue.
Use this when something adheres to or clings to something else, including a person clinging to another person.

examples.english: This piece of tape can adhere to the bottom of the cup.
examples.traditional: 呢塊膠紙黐住咗個杯底。
examples.jyutping: ne1 faai3 gaau1 zi2 ci1 zyu6 zo2 go3 bui1 dai2

examples.english: I used glue to stick the poster to the wall.
examples.traditional: 我用膠水將張海報黐住喺幅牆度。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 gaau1 seoi2 zoeng1 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 ci1 zyu6 hai2 fuk1 coeng4 dou6

examples.english: The child likes to attach himself to me whenever we go out.
examples.traditional: 個細路一出街就黐住我。
examples.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 jat1 ceot1 gaai1 zau6 ci1 zyu6 ngo5
